name: Administrative Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2024 – 4:00 p.m.
  .

To provide Public Comments, you may attend in-person at City Hall or submit your written
comments via email to the City Clerk's Office (cityclerk@wlv.org) no later than 11:00 a.m. on the
meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Administrative Committee Members prior to
the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-Supplemental-Packets

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
 Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER  4:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Davis, Mayor Pro Tem Honig

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Administrative Committee on items not on the printed agenda
and within the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three
minutes.

BUSINESS:

1.  Bond Investments Update – Staff and Stifle to present an update on the bond
  portfolio performance, matured bonds and purchased bonds.

2.  Traffic Engineering Services Request for Proposal – Staff to present scope of
  services and timeline for the Request For Proposal for review and input.

3.  Code Enforcement Program – Follow up discussion from the September 11,
  2024, Council Study Session on possible modifications to the Code Enforcement
  Program that would include the ability to issue Administrative Citations for
  violations of the Municipal Code.

4.  2025-35 Strategic Plan – Update on the 2025-35 Strategic Plan process and
  contract recommendation with True North Research for community survey and
  consulting support.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, October 11, 2024 at 2:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  October 11, 2024
